name: 7-banme no Tsuki
source:
The mountain town of Zenno City has a long history. A white school building towers over the peaceful townscape. It is Meisho Academy, a private boarding school for junior high and high school students. Yuno Nagatsuki, a student in the high school division, lived a peaceful school life with her friends Angela and Albiera, who lived in the same dormitory, and her classmate Isa Roussel. 
Everyday life repeated without incident. Without questioning the ordinary days that simply repeated themselves...
translation:
山城泽诺市有着悠久的历史。一座白色的校舍耸立在宁静的城镇景观之上。这是一所私立寄宿学校，招收初中生和高中生。高中部的学生长月由乃，与住在同一宿舍的好友安吉拉、阿尔比拉以及同班同学伊莎·鲁塞尔一起过着平静的学校生活。
日常生活毫无意外地重复着。不去质疑那些简单重复的平凡日子……
